turns.q: How long will delivery take, roughly?
turns.replyTail:
For an in-stock item, allow 1–3 business days for it to leave the warehouse, then another 1–5 business days for delivery, so roughly 2–8 business days total.

Promotions and holidays can add 2–3 business days. If an item has extended processing or is a pre-order, its estimated ship date appears on the product page, in the cart, and in your order confirmation.
